info.text:
Under 35? The Fed says typical net worth fell 23%.
The Fed's 2025 Survey of Consumer Finances (released Oct 9, 2026): median net worth for households under 35 fell 23% from 2022 to $33,000, inflation-adjusted.
Households 75 and older rose 37% to $504,900, driven mainly by retirement accounts.
Nearly 1 in 5 families were behind on loan payments, the most since the 2010 survey; more than 8% were at least two months behind, up from 5% in 2022.
Overall median net worth rose 2% to $215,900.
Sources: Federal Reserve Board, CNBC, CBS News, Quartz.
News and education, not financial advice.
